name: The Lenihan Case
source:
Kath and Morgan are co-workers in an investigation company. They're working on a mysterious case of a house fire and have different theories on it. Unbeknownst to the duo, they’re mutually pining.

[From [url=https://venus-lair.itch.io/the-lenihan-case]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
凯丝和摩根是一家调查公司的同事。他们正在调查一桩神秘的房屋火灾案件，对此有不同的理论。两人不知道的是，他们互相渴望。

[来自[url=https://venus-lair.itch.io/the-lenihan-case]Itch.io[/url]]
